highlights: Review staged, unstaged, and untracked files in Git View, preview inline diffs, and open working files in the Viewer or Editor.
File-pane breadcrumbs show the full local path whenever it fits and restore hidden folders as the pane widens.
Resize text with Ctrl+Wheel in Folder shortcuts, Options, Terminal, the command line, Compare files, and the main interface.
Share one folder directly from Dirlume and invite another Dirlume app on the local network to browse and download files.
